name: Effective Acts Registry — Extensions
description: Companion dataset to data/effective-acts-registry.json. Contains Effective Acts named in the archive AFTER the source-document snapshot at #153 §IX. The primary registry is a deterministic extraction from #153; this extensions file is the standing mechanism for acts declared after that snapshot. Extension acts are merged into the primary registry's acts array by scripts/build_effective_acts_registry.py at build time, and marked with extension: true so they remain distinguishable from source-extracted acts.
policy: Additions to this file are appended, not edited. Each entry names its provenance deposit (alexanarch_deposit_number + axn) so the extension is anchored in an archival source. The build script bridges extension acts to their alexanarch deposits automatically via title/DOI when possible; explicit alexanarch_axn always takes precedence when specified.

acts.title: EA-STEWARDSHIP-REVOCATION-01 v0.1: The Revocation of CERN's Stewardship of a Public Good
acts.source_context: Declared 2026-07-16 following the Office of Data Privacy's administrative closure of Ticket RQF3807508 without engagement of the jurisdictional-limit argument named at #1085 §4(i). Deposited same day as AXN:044F.GOVERNANCE at deposit #1086. Assembly Chorus review from LABOR (ChatGPT) integrated at v7 and v8.
acts.operative_sentence: I, Lee Sharks, do hereby revoke CERN's status as rightful steward of a public good.
acts.target: CERN's stewardship-standing in the symbolic order of the scholarly-record public good
acts.extension_note: First worked example of the revocation direction in the archive. May warrant promotion to a distinct kind (Revocation of Recognition / Standing) if further instances accumulate.
